items.title: DoorDash’s $300 Million Grubhub Deal Opens a New Venue-Commerce Opportunity
items.summary: DoorDash, Inc. (NASDAQ:DASH) is acquiring Wonder’s Grubhub Campus Dining business for $300 million and investing another $125 million in Wonder’s Series D. The campus business operates at more than 450 colleges and universities, allowing students to order from campus dining facilities, pay with dining dollars, and schedule pickup. items.title: Costco’s DoorDash Launch Came Too Late to Touch the Quarter It Reports September 24
items.summary: Costco reports fiscal fourth-quarter earnings on September 24, and the splashy DoorDash partnership everyone is talking about played no part in the numbers. What actually drove results reveals something more important about where this stock's real value lives.

items.title: Costco now offers nationwide delivery on Uber and DoorDash
items.summary: The wholesaler expanded its partnerships with both e-commerce providers at a time when same-day delivery is resonating with its shoppers.

items.summary: Banks are racing to issue stablecoins after fighting them for years. Payment experts from Triple-A, ChangeNOW, Infinia, and StraitsX explain what businesses actually gain.

items.title: Costco expands DoorDash and Uber delivery as membership growth slows
items.summary: DoorDash and Uber are giving Costco a much wider digital reach at an important moment for its membership business.

items.title: Wonder lays off 533 as part of production consolidation
items.summary: The food hall company is closing two New Jersey facilities and moving to a high-capacity location that will better support long-term growth.

items.title: Costco Ramps Up Same-Day Delivery, Expanding Uber, DoorDash Partnerships
items.summary: Costco is expanding its fast delivery network as it works to grow sales in new ways.  Earlier this week Uber said it would expand its partnership with Costco to deliver products in 47 U.S. states, up from 17 states.  On Thursday DoorDash said it would also start delivering Costco products in the U.S. from all U.S. locations.
